_comment: LTC true solo, as its own independent node.
There is no merged or 'dual' LTC+DOGE mining here and there cannot be:
Dogecoin removed auxpow in 2014 (v1.6). LTC and DOGE are two separate
chains with two separate daemons, two separate wallets and two separate
block rewards. A shared stratum endpoint would mine one chain's blocks
and pay them to the other chain's address, which is unspendable.
